ideas.title: ESP32-Powered Micro Robot Arm
ideas.summary: A small robot arm built with servos and 3D-printed parts, controlled remotely from a smartphone via an ESP32 microcontroller.

ideas.title: Automated Camera Slider for Hyperlapses
ideas.summary: A stepper motor moves a camera slowly along a rail while it shoots, enabling smooth hyperlapse footage.

ideas.title: Pan-Tilt Camera Tracker
ideas.summary: A camera system with a pan-tilt head that automatically tracks and follows a person within the frame, keeping them centered as they move. The concept explores themes of surveillance and constant observation.

ideas.title: Automatic Plant Watering System
ideas.summary: A self-sustaining plant watering system that uses a soil moisture sensor and a small pump to automatically keep a plant watered.

ideas.title: ESP32 Weather Station with Web Dashboard
ideas.summary: Build a weather station using an ESP32 microcontroller and a BME280 sensor to measure temperature, humidity, and pressure, displaying the data on a web dashboard.

ideas.title: Reaction-Time LED Game
ideas.summary: A game where LEDs light up at random intervals and the player must press a button as fast as possible, tracking the best score on a small screen.

ideas.title: Ultrasonic Distance Meter
ideas.summary: A device that measures distance using ultrasonic waves and beeps faster as the object gets closer, useful as a parking sensor.

ideas.title: Lab Occupancy Counter
ideas.summary: A system that uses an infrared beam at the door to count people entering and leaving a lab.

ideas.title: RFID Tool Check-out Logger
ideas.summary: A system that logs tool borrows and returns by tapping a card, helping the lab track equipment usage.

ideas.title: Scrolling LED Matrix Schedule Sign
ideas.summary: An LED matrix display that shows the next Tech Lab lesson from the lab schedule, scrolling the upcoming class information for students.

ideas.title: Ultrasonic Theremin
ideas.summary: A theremin that uses ultrasonic sensors to detect hand position and modulate the pitch of a buzzer or speaker.

ideas.title: Line-Following Robot Car
ideas.summary: A robot car that follows a line using infrared sensors to navigate a predefined path autonomously.

ideas.title: Self-Balancing Two-Wheeled Robot
ideas.summary: Build a two-wheeled robot that maintains balance using an MPU6050 motion sensor and a control algorithm.

ideas.title: Wi-Fi RGB Mood Lamp
ideas.summary: A mood lamp with a WS2812 LED strip controlled remotely through a web page, allowing users to change colors and lighting effects from their browser.

ideas.title: Pomodoro Timer with OLED and Buzzer
ideas.summary: A Pomodoro timer device featuring an OLED display and a buzzer for time-based focus sessions.

ideas.title: Motion-Activated Desk Light
ideas.summary: A desk lamp that automatically turns on when a PIR motion sensor detects movement nearby.

ideas.title: MIDI Controller with Knobs and Sliders
ideas.summary: A hardware MIDI controller featuring knobs and sliders designed to control music software, enabling hands-on manipulation of parameters during live performance or production.

ideas.title: Bluetooth Gamepad for Unity Games
ideas.summary: A gamepad controlled by an ESP32 microcontroller, designed to connect wirelessly to Unity-based games.

ideas.title: Noise-Level Traffic Light for the Lab
ideas.summary: A system that displays green, yellow, or red lights as the room's noise level increases, helping the lab stay quiet.

ideas.title: Simon Says Memory Game
ideas.summary: A memory game inspired by the classic Simon toy, featuring coloured buttons, LEDs, and sound effects.

ideas.title: Musical LED Fashion Garment
ideas.summary: A wearable garment with sewn-in LEDs that light up and pulse in response to music, blending fashion with interactive lighting.

ideas.title: Cycling Jacket with Turn Signals
ideas.summary: A cycling jacket featuring a button on the sleeve that controls blinking turn signals on the back, allowing cyclists to signal left or right turns.

ideas.title: Self-Illuminating Handbag
ideas.summary: A handbag that lights up its interior when opened, helping users quickly locate items like keys.

ideas.title: 3D-Printed Jewellery Collection
ideas.summary: Design a collection of rings, earrings, and pendants created using 3D printing technology.

ideas.title: Electronic Cajón with Piezo Sensors
ideas.summary: A cajón instrument fitted with piezo sensors that trigger drum samples and illuminate when played, combining acoustic percussion with electronic sound design.

ideas.title: Podcast Corner in the Media Lab
ideas.summary: A small recording setup with two microphones, a simple recorder, and an 'on air' indicator light mounted over the door.

ideas.title: Stop-Motion Animation Booth
ideas.summary: A phone mounted on a stand paired with a foot pedal that captures each frame, enabling hands-free stop-motion animation.

ideas.title: Green-Screen Video Booth
ideas.summary: A green-screen video booth for quick student interviews and project videos.

ideas.title: Light Painting Photography with LED Wand
ideas.summary: Create long-exposure photographs by drawing words and shapes in the air using a homemade LED wand. The project explores light painting techniques and hands-on electronics for controlling the light source.

ideas.title: Plant Growth Time-lapse with Raspberry Pi
ideas.summary: Capture a month-long plant growth time-lapse using a Raspberry Pi camera, producing a smooth timelapse video of the plant's development.

ideas.title: DIY Ring Light and Light Box for Product
ideas.summary: A student wants to build a homemade ring light and light box to improve product photography, likely for e-commerce or social media content.

ideas.title: 3D Scanned Classmate Figure
ideas.summary: Scan a classmate using a 3D scanner and print a small figurine of them.

ideas.title: 3D-Printed Replacement Parts for Lab Equipment
ideas.summary: Design and 3D-print replacement components such as knobs, clips, feet, and covers for broken laboratory equipment to extend the life of existing instruments.

ideas.title: Collaborative 3D-Printed Chess Set
ideas.summary: A chess set designed collectively by the class, with each piece created by a different student and printed in the 3D printing lab.

ideas.title: 3D-Printed Desk Organiser
ideas.summary: A desk organiser designed and 3D printed for use on lab tables.

ideas.title: Lab Zine
ideas.summary: A printed zine about the lab and its projects, produced in the university printing lab.

ideas.title: Lab Poster Series
ideas.summary: A poster series showcasing student projects from the lab.

ideas.title: Screen-Printed Lab T-Shirts
ideas.summary: Design and produce lab t-shirts featuring the Tech Lab logo using screen-printing techniques.

ideas.title: Custom Laptop Stickers
ideas.summary: Design and print custom laptop stickers in the printing lab, offering a creative outlet for students to showcase their artwork.

ideas.title: 3D-Printed Board Game Prototype
ideas.summary: A board game prototype featuring 3D-printed game pieces and printed cards.

ideas.title: Student Arcade Cabinet
ideas.summary: A compact arcade cabinet designed to play games created by students, providing a shared platform for showcasing student-made games.

ideas.title: Fruit-Based Game Controller
ideas.summary: A game controller constructed from bananas and other fruits, inspired by the Makey Makey concept, intended for use in a game jam.

ideas.title: Escape Room Puzzle Box
ideas.summary: A puzzle box that opens only when the correct sequence is solved, using an Arduino-controlled lock to reward the player.

ideas.title: Augmented Reality Poster
ideas.summary: A poster that transforms into an interactive experience when viewed through a smartphone camera, bringing static printed content to life with augmented reality effects.

ideas.title: Interactive Sound Wall
ideas.summary: A wall with painted spots that play sounds when touched, using capacitive touch sensing.

ideas.title: Touch-Dimmer 3D-Printed Lamp
ideas.summary: A lamp designed and 3D printed by students, featuring a touch-based dimmer control.

ideas.title: Interactive Reactive Shop Window
ideas.summary: A shop window display that detects passersby and responds with dynamic lighting and sound effects to attract attention for marketing purposes.

ideas.title: QR Code Campaign Poster with Live Counter
ideas.summary: A campaign poster featuring a QR code that tracks and displays how many people have scanned it, creating an interactive and measurable promotional tool.

ideas.title: 3D-Printed Strobe Zoetrope
ideas.summary: A zoetrope built with a 3D-printed frame and a strobe LED to animate the spinning image sequence.

ideas.title: Projection Mapping on 3D-Printed Object
ideas.summary: Project animated visuals onto a 3D-printed object to create an animation showcase, combining physical fabrication with dynamic light-based visuals.
